# Test Scenario: ContainedModal stack provider

<!-- scenario-metadata:end -->

## Description

A `Stack.Host` with `modalProviderContainerId` is the provider of the contained modals that target it. In this scenario such a stack takes the part of the screen below the "Outside" pressable. Its screen renders a modal over content and a modal replacing content, and its header has an item that counts its presses.

It validates that a modal covers the stack, its header included, and nothing else. It guards against two regressions: a header item that takes presses although a modal covers it, and a stack that does not come back in its full size after a modal replacing content is closed.

## Note

- A pressable changes its color while it is pressed. A registered press increases the number in its label by one.
- The modal over content has a dashed frame with "Press here" in its top right corner. The frame lies over the header item of the stack.

## Steps

### Baseline

1. Navigate to the **ContainedModal stack provider** scenario.

    - [ ] The "Outside" pressable is shown at the top. Below it the stack is shown, with "Root" and the "Header: 0" item in its header, and the "Root: 0" pressable in its screen.

2. Press the "Header" item, then the "Root" pressable.

    - [ ] They show "Header: 1" and "Root: 1".

---

### Modal over content

1. Tap "Open modal over content".

    - [ ] A yellow modal covers the stack, its header included.
    - [ ] The "Outside" pressable is not covered.

2. Press inside the "Press here" frame.

    - [ ] Nothing changes.

3. Press the "Outside" pressable, then the "Modal over content" pressable.

    - [ ] They show "Outside: 1" and "Modal over content: 1".

4. Tap "Close".

    - [ ] The modal is dismissed. The header item still shows "Header: 1", and the pressable in the screen still shows "Root: 1".

---

### Modal replacing content

1. Tap "Open modal replacing content".

    - [ ] A yellow modal covers the stack, its header included.
    - [ ] The "Outside" pressable is not covered.

2. Tap "Close".

    - [ ] The modal is dismissed. The stack takes the same area as before, with its header and its screen, and they still show "Header: 1" and "Root: 1".

3. Press the "Header" item, then the "Root" pressable.

    - [ ] They show "Header: 2" and "Root: 2".
